howto.name: Upload an .xlsx file
howto.text: Drop an Excel workbook up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools converts each sheet to a PDF page
howto.text: Each sheet, hidden ones included, is drawn as a plain table on landscape A4 pages in 8 pt Helvetica, over one or more pages. Only cell values come across: number and date formats, colours, fonts, and column widths are not kept, the columns share the page width equally, and text too long for its column is cut short.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: Click Convert. The output PDF has one section per worksheet.

faq.a: No. Each formula shows the result saved with the workbook the last time a spreadsheet app calculated it. Files written by tools that do not store those results show formula cells as blank.
They are left out: only cell values are converted, so charts, pictures, and shapes do not appear. Office to PDF, which uses LibreOffice, includes them.

faq.q: How does it handle very wide sheets?
faq.a: All columns are squeezed across one landscape A4 page and long values are cut short to fit, so very wide sheets become hard to read. The header row is not repeated on later pages.
